title: Three-arrow reduction for a relative category with homotopy fractions
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,W)$ be a category with a wide subcategory admitting the two-sided homotopy calculus of fractions of [def-coef-zigzag-homotopy-calculus]. For any objects $x,y$, reducing each string of commuting three-arrow zigzags defines a simplicial map
$$NZ_{-+-}(x,y)\longrightarrow L^H(\mathcal C,W)(x,y),$$
where $Z_{-+-}$, its morphisms and its nerve are as in [def-coef-zigzag-homotopy-calculus], and the right side is the hammock simplicial set of [lem-coef-hammock-infinity-localization]. This map is a weak homotopy equivalence. No model structure, cofibrancy, fibrancy or properness assumption is imposed on $\mathcal C,x,y$.
